clips.title: The story
paras: Astor Hadren carries a letter between Silverpine Forest and the Undercity. Deathstalkers use it to pose as the courier and investigate Andron Gant, a shopkeeper suspected of leaking Forsaken intelligence.

Astor Hadren carries messages between Silverpine Forest and the Undercity. His letter of introduction gives its bearer credentials with illicit contacts in the city. Mennet Carkad, a Deathstalker handler, needs to investigate suspicious leaks in the Undercity, and Astor's travels make him a target. An operative can eliminate Astor and take his papers, then assume his identity and intercept the covert messages meant for him.
